Reconstructed the Urdu body in [sham-ghriban-ka-ye-mnzr-hai.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/3/workspaces/5b457adde6984f0e864f19898dfc729a/src/data/lyrics/sham-ghriban-ka-ye-mnzr-hai.md) and retained the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. All 11 blocks match verse for verse. The file now uses right-to-left direction, includes a Roman alternate title, and no longer carries the `noUrdu` tag.

I read `rut gaye` as `روٹھ گئے` and rendered the ambiguous `Sare kahani` as `سارے کہانی`, preserving the recorded wording.
